title: Event
description: Calendar event or conference with date/time, location, venue, organizer, capacity, pricing, and online/offline status. Used for event management, calendar applications, and conference booking systems.

category.description: Event category (e.g., Conference, Workshop, Concert, Sports, Networking)

location.description: Street address of the event location

city.description: City where the event takes place

country.description: Country where the event takes place

venue.description: Venue name where the event is held

organizer.description: Name of the organization or person organizing the event

capacity.description: Maximum number of attendees the event can accommodate

currency.description: ISO currency code for the price (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP)

is_online.description: Whether the event is held online/virtual or in-person

url.description: Event website URL or registration link
